threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest tube and avoid the number 38 bus like it's the plague. Just wait till you know the shortcuts.
Caught the N37 last night, and the driver was belting out 90s R&B like it was karaoke. Gave everyone a laugh while we crawled past the closed pubs.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh kebab merging with the sound of a street artist playing jazz on Karl-Marx-Straße had me hooked—pure Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can spot spontaneous dance parties in the middle of the street, especially when the weather’s nice. It’s like a flash mob, but Berlin just calls it Tuesday.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who's local by their reaction to the Muni delays; real ones just roll their eyes and keep scrolling their phones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that had a guy playing a saxophone, while another passenger was trying to sell homemade bracelets. Only in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is all about trendy bars, but they miss the small bakeries that open at dawn, where the real local mornings start.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by how they awkwardly navigate the bus system, clutching their T10 card like a lifeline while staring at Google Maps.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground' – that gives you away every time.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week, had to sidestep a guy trying to start a dance-off in the aisle. Only in South London, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the local Turkish bakery learned my name and started adding extra pastries to my order. That’s when I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a döner at 3 AM, then find a spontaneous open-air techno party in the park. Feels like the city never sleeps.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to give a wide berth to the BART Civic Center station during any whiff of smoke. Tourists just stare, phones in hand.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 19 bus, casually wearing flip-flops. Only in San Francisco do you level up and down at the same time.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the nightlife, but many of us prefer the quiet plazas for our evening chats over cerveses.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they still stare in awe at the Güell Park mosaics, taking photos from every angle, while locals just breeze by.
